title: Double Command OFF Variant Request
purpose: Differentiate control coverage from the single-command seed by using TypeID 46 double command semantics and a different command byte, creating a distinct command parser path rather than a cosmetic ON/OFF duplicate.
expected_behavior: Parses as a 104 I-format C_DC_NA_1 double command request carrying one information object and a command-state byte distinct from the single-command seed, exercising a separate control ASDU path.
constraints_preserved: TypeID 46 for C_DC_NA_1 taken from supplied function reference
Length octet 0x0e matches 14 bytes following it
ASDU field order preserved with VSQ, COT, common address, IOA, and one command byte
Uses a different IOA and TypeID from the single-command seed to avoid cosmetic duplication
issue_safety_notes: PK-only seed; no vulnerability analogue required. Uses safe structural diversity by switching command family and payload semantics instead of replaying malformed OFF data.
